basic_details.job_title: DLSA West Karbi Anglong Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 20 Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Legal Services Authority, West Karbi Anglong (DLSA West Karbi Anglong) has notified 20 temporary vacancies for the Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) post. Candidates can apply offline by post or in person to the Office of the District Legal Services Authority, West Karbi Anglong, Judicial Courts & Offices compound, Sai - Ali on or before 30 November 2026, starting from 12 October 2026. Applicants must hold a Matriculation (10th) qualification. The work does not carry any salary, remuneration or wage except honorarium fixed by the District Legal Services Authority from time to time. content_sections.heading: DLSA West Karbi Anglong Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) at a Glance

rows.details: District Legal Services Authority, West Karbi Anglong, Hamren
No salary, remuneration or wage except honorarium fixed by the District Legal Services Authority from time to time
Matriculation (10th standard) pass with overall comprehension and a mindset to assist society

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Filled-up applications along with self-attested copies of relevant testimonials of educational qualification, age proof, and caste, plus two recent passport-size photographs (one pasted on the application form and another stapled on top) should be submitted to the following postal address: Office of the District Legal Services Authority, West Karbi Anglong, Judicial Courts & Offices compound, Sai - Ali, Hamren, Pin - 782486, Assam Applicants must provide their phone number (preferably WhatsApp No.) and E-mail ID in the application form. Applications may be sent by post, but the authority will not be responsible for postal delays.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: The applicant should have passed Matriculation with a capacity for overall comprehension as well as a mindset to assist the needy in society with compassion, empathy, and concern for the upliftment of marginalized and weaker sections. Citizenship: The applicant must be a citizen of India and a resident of the West Karbi Anglong district. Age Limit: Minimum 18 years as on 12.10.2026. Eligible Groups: Eligible applicants may belong to teachers (including retired teachers), retired government servants and senior citizens, M.S.W. students and teachers, Anganwadi workers, doctors/physicians, students and law students (till they enrol as lawyers), members of non-political service-oriented NGOs and clubs, members of women neighbourhood groups, Maithri Singhams and other self-help groups including marginalized/vulnerable groups, educated prisoners with good behaviour serving long-term sentences in prisons, or any other person whom DLSA deems fit.

rows.pay: Honorarium fixed by DLSA from time to time

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification testimonials Age proof certificate Caste certificate Two recent passport-size photographs (one pasted on the designated place and one stapled on top)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of an interview of shortlisted candidates after scrutiny of applications. The list of shortlisted candidates for the interview, the date of interview, and other information regarding the selection process will be notified on the official website of the West Karbi Anglong District Judiciary (https://westkarbianglong.dcourts.gov.in). No individual call letters will be issued.

faq.question: Q1. Is there any salary or regular wage for the PLV post?
faq.answer: No, the work of PLVs does not carry any salary, remuneration, or wage except an honorarium fixed by the District Legal Services Authority from time to time.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the shortlist and interview details appear?
faq.answer: The list of shortlisted candidates for the interview, interview dates, and selection notifications will be published on the official website of the West Karbi Anglong District Judiciary at https://westkarbianglong.dcourts.gov.in. No individual call letters will be issued.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Indian citizens who are residents of the West Karbi Anglong district, have passed Matriculation (10th), are at least 18 years old as on 12.10.2026, and belong to specified groups such as teachers, retired government servants, MSW students/teachers, Anganwadi workers, doctors, law students, NGO members, SHG members, or prisoners with good behavior can apply.

faq.question: Q4. Can applications be submitted after the last date?
faq.answer: No application will be entertained after the last date of submission, which is 30.11.2026 till 5.00 pm.
